brief:
Israel has returned the body of 15-year-old Palestinian Jadallah Jihad Jumaa Jadallah, whom its forces shot dead in November 2025, Middle East Eye reported. Palestinian authorities received his remains after an extended period during which Israeli authorities had retained the body.

The teenager was killed during an operational event in the occupied territories. Details regarding the specific circumstances of the shooting and the length of time Israeli forces held his body before returning it were not specified in available accounts.

title: Israel returns body of Palestinian teenager shot in 2025
